Q41422.description: award or recognition received by a person, organization or creative work

Q41422.label: image
Q41422.description: image of relevant illustration of the subject; if available, also use more specific properties (sample: coat of arms image, locator map, flag image, signature image, logo image, collage image)

Q41422.label: place of birth
Q41422.description: most specific known (e.g. city instead of country, or hospital instead of city) birth location of a person, animal or fictional character

Q41422.label: sex or gender
Q41422.description: sex or gender identity of human or animal. For human: male, female, non-binary, intersex, transgender female, transgender male, agender, etc. For animal: male organism, female organism. Groups of same gender use subclass of (P279)

Q41422.label: spouse
Q41422.description: the subject has the object as their spouse (husband, wife, partner, etc.). Use "unmarried partner" (P451) for non-married companions

Q41422.label: country of citizenship
Q41422.description: the object is a country that recognizes the subject as its citizen

Q41422.label: instance of
Q41422.description: that class of which this subject is a particular example and member; different from P279 (subclass of); for example: K2 is an instance of mountain; volcano is a subclass of mountain (and an instance of volcanic landform)

Q41422.label: child
Q41422.description: subject has object as child. Do not use for stepchildren—use "relative" (P1038), qualified with "type of kinship" (P1039)

Q41422.label: educated at
Q41422.description: educational institution attended by subject

Q41422.label: medical condition
Q41422.description: any state relevant to the health of an organism, including diseases and positive conditions

Q41422.label: filmography
Q41422.description: item for the list of films a person has contributed to. Don't use it to add film items. Instead, add actors as "cast member" (P161) on items for films, directors with "director" (P57)

Q41422.label: described by source
Q41422.description: work where this item is described

Q41422.label: nominated for
Q41422.description: award nomination received by a person, organisation or creative work (inspired from "award received" (Property:P166))

Q41422.label: languages spoken, written or signed
Q41422.description: language(s) that a person or a people speaks, writes or signs, including the native language(s)

Q41422.label: birth name
Q41422.description: full name of a person at birth, if different from their current, generally used name

Q41422.label: lifestyle
Q41422.description: typical way of life of an individual, group, or culture

Q41422.label: number of children
Q41422.description: number of children of the person

Q41422.label: work period (start)
Q41422.description: start of period during which a person or group flourished (fl. = "floruit") in their professional activity

Q41422.label: height
Q41422.description: vertical length of an entity

Q41422.label: Commons category
Q41422.description: name of the Wikimedia Commons category containing files related to this item (without the prefix "Category:")

Q41422.label: residence
Q41422.description: the place where the person is or has been, resident

Q41422.label: date of birth
Q41422.description: date on which the subject was born

Q41422.label: family name
Q41422.description: part of full name of person

Q41422.label: given name
Q41422.description: first name or another given name of this person; values used with the property should not link disambiguations nor family names

Q41422.label: social media followers
Q41422.description: number of subscribers on a particular social media website (use as main statement only; see P3744 instead for qualifier). Qualify with "point in time" and property for account. For Twitter, use numeric id.
